entry.title: Taylor Formula with Symmetric Lagrange Remainder

content.markdown: For distinct real points `x₀` and `x`, if `f′` and `f′′` are derivatives of `f` and `f′`, respectively, then the second-order Taylor formula at `x₀` holds at `x` with a Lagrange remainder evaluated at some `ξ` between the two points. The interval is written with `min` and `max`, so the statement handles either endpoint order.
